description: Core forecasting engine: Implement Holt-Winters exponential smoothing algorithm in PHP, queued job for batch forecast generation, and Artisan console command with scheduling for automatic daily regeneration.
steps: Create app/Services/ConsumptionForecastService.php with method predictNextMonths(Zone $zone, int $months = 6): array. Implement Holt-Winters (exponential smoothing with seasonality). Algorithm: (1) Initialize level L, trend T, seasonal factors S from first 12 months of historical data. (2) For each historical month, update L, T, S using smoothing parameters α=0.3, β=0.1, γ=0.1. (3) For each forecast month (1..6), compute prediction = (L + month×T) × S[seasonal_index]. (4) Confidence intervals: lower = prediction × 0.85, upper = prediction × 1.15. (5) Compute MAE on hold-out set (last 3 historical months predicted vs. actual). Return array: ['predictions' => [...], 'lower_bounds' => [...], 'upper_bounds' => [...], 'mae' => float, 'model' => 'holt_winters'].

Create app/Jobs/GenerateConsumptionForecasts.php implementing ShouldQueue. Constructor: receives Zone $zone. Handle method: (1) Call ConsumptionForecastService::predictNextMonths($zone, 6). (2) For each forecast month, upsert row into consumption_forecasts table with (zone_id, forecast_month, prediction_m3, lower_bound, upper_bound, model_used='holt_winters', mae). Use upsertUsing or firstOrCreate/update pattern.

Create app/Console/Commands/RefreshForecasts.php with command signature 'drought:refresh-forecasts'. In handle(): (1) Fetch all zones. (2) For each zone, dispatch GenerateConsumptionForecasts job or call it synchronously if fast. (3) Output: 'Forecasts regenerated for N zones.'
Test manually: php artisan drought:refresh-forecasts and verify consumption_forecasts table has rows for all zones.
acceptance_criteria: ConsumptionForecastService correctly implements Holt-Winters and returns valid predictions with confidence intervals.
GenerateConsumptionForecasts job successfully upserts forecast data into DB.
RefreshForecasts command runs without errors and regenerates forecasts for all zones.
Kernel schedule includes the command with dailyAt('23:00').
consumption_forecasts table contains 30+ rows after running the command (5 zones × 6 months each).
verification: php artisan drought:refresh-forecasts (completes with success message)
mysql -u root -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aquasecure.consumption_forecasts;" (output: 30 or more)
mysql -u root -e "SELECT forecast_month, prediction_m3, model_used FROM aquasecure.consumption_forecasts LIMIT 5;" (shows correct data)
